thread:
alex: Quick async — optkit delivery status? specifically need current owner for quant recommendations + who owns the batching/caching rollout plan. trying to map deps for next week's milestone.

maria: I'm the lead on quant recs now. finishing draft of profiles for gpt-like and dense-embed workloads. PR out in ~2 hrs. ping @derek for perf numbers. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

derek: got it. running perf runs on the new INT8 kernels, will push numbers by EOD. seeing a weird tail-latency bump when batch size > 8 on A100. logging details in the perf dashboard.

sam: for batching/caching, i'm the owner of the rollout plan. main dependency is the KV-cache infra change that eng-infra is shipping. outage window scheduled Friday midnight — can we avoid? cc @karen for infra impact.

karen: infra prefers a canary first instead of a mass migration. we can open a 1-hour canary slot Thu 02:00 UTC. no midnight outages.

alex: OK canary Thu 02:00 UTC. maria/derek — do the quant profiles assume new kernel behavior or legacy? we need compatibility matrix for rollback.

maria: profiles built against legacy kernels but with notes for kernel-specific flags. will add a compatibility table to the PR.

derek: experiments done on the INT8 kernels; I can repro on legacy too but perf numbers differ. I'll add a short matrix: {kernel: [latency, throughput]} in the perf doc.

sam: important: batching changes will change tokenization latency distribution. we should add a regression alert rule in the monitoring stack for 95p latency + token/sec drop. can ops-bot create the alert?

ci-bot: created alert "optkit_batched_95p_latency_regression" -> threshold 600ms, notify #eng-sre and #eng-runtime.

alex: awesome, thanks. two quick blockers: (1) canary needs a safety fallback to previous model variant on errors, (2) documentation for SDK flags so existing customers aren't surprised. who owns each?

maria: I can own the SDK flags doc; will add examples and note behavior for cached prefixes. ETA Thu morning.

sam: fallback policy is on the rollout plan — I'll add explicit config for "fallback_model": "previous" and a kill-switch. will update the runbook.

derek: one more note — the tail-latency bump correlates with a specific prompt length distribution we weren't testing. gating regression eval should include that prompt set. I'll attach the prompt set to the PR.

alex: perfect. Can we get a short summary for the stakeholders? owners + ETA + blockers. I'll send to PMs after we confirm.

maria: summary: owner=Maria (quant recs) PR by Thu noon; Derek perf matrix + prompt set by EOD today; Sam rollout + fallback runbook by Wed EOD; Canary Thu 02:00 UTC; infra ok with canary. Blockers: tail-latency investigation (Derek) and KV-cache infra change (Karen -> resolved for canary).

alex: thanks. last ask — @derek @maria please add a tiny regression test in the optkit CI that runs the prompt set with both kernels, so we catch regressions on PRs. one-liner test is fine.

derek: will add a unit/ci job: ``run_regression_promptset.sh --kernels [legacy,int8]`` and a short acceptance threshold.

sam: tagging this thread as the canonical async update for the milestone. I'll update the project board with the owners. :white_check_mark:

alex: great. if anything shifts ping here; otherwise i'll close the loop with PMs in a few hours. :rocket:
